parent_objective: run no-training constructor source smoke on M1421 outcome rows
blocked_by: M1424 implementation must be run on public M1421 rows before any closed-loop replay probe

public_gates: M1425 must use the M1424 constructor on public M1421 outcome rows only
M1425 must report candidate_rows outcome_pressure_rows and history_positive proxy rows separately
M1425 must keep proxy_only and requires_replay flags explicit
M1425 must not run closed-loop replay outcome interventions train run PPO promote use private holdout export training corpus or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not export a training corpus
do not count reset or zero-current as history-positive
do not claim proxy rows as closed-loop evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs the implemented constructor on public M1421 rows to test whether source-diverse proxy pressure rows exist
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public constructor source smoke only; no closed-loop replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if history_positive diversity is below 6 seeds or 6 capability pairs
stop if controls are counted as history-positive
stop if outputs are not marked proxy_only and requires_replay
fallback_plan: audit as source-limited if proxy pressure rows are sparse
tighten or revise candidate constructor if controls contaminate history-positive accounting
admit a separately registered closed-loop replay probe only if source smoke gates pass

admission_evidence: M1424 implemented constructor and focused tests
M1423 requires a source smoke before replay or training
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up replay-probe or audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: history-positive proxy rows are not control-only

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1425 is still proxy source construction and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: wrong-history and same-recent wrong-history variant counts
source diversity before any replay probe
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1421 public outcome rows processed by M1424 constructor.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If source-diverse proxy rows are not available, record a source-limited negative and audit before changing task design.
allowed_claims: no closed-loop replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1424 constructor can find enough source-diverse action-divergent proxy pressure rows in M1421 public outcome artifacts to justify a later replay probe.
success_criteria: summary marks proxy_only true and requires_replay true
failure_criteria: candidate rows or pressure rows are sparse
history-positive rows are control-only or not source-diverse
outputs are not marked proxy_only and requires_replay
run starts closed-loop replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input changes
decision_rule: M1425 passes if the no-training constructor emits source-diverse proxy pressure rows without crossing any forbidden shortcut.
